title: Broader Distribution / Low-Bandwidth Search Before
slide_intent: Inspect constrained delivery conditions because a brand can lose its intended appearance when assets cannot be served.
strategic_value: A smaller logo asset can help Google retain consistent recognition on low-bandwidth connections, as the article explains.
demonstration: The short clip labeled Before compares two phone screens: a standard old Google logo and a simpler text-like low-bandwidth version. The available clip does not show an After comparison.
practical_value: Compare the actual fallback appearance with the intended mark before deciding an asset-size reduction is merely a technical change.
